title: Contract GPU Reservation Logbook Q3 2025
summary: Working spreadsheet tracking per-contract Dedicated GPU reservations, allocation pools, current utilization and short-term rebalancing recommendations. Includes burst allowances and billing tier mappings. Draft for customer ops + sales review.
body:
HEADER ROW:
Contract ID | Customer | Region(s) | Primary GPU Type | Reserved GPUs | Monthly Hrs Allocated | Burst (hrs/month) | Start | End | SLA latency (p95) | Allocation Pool | 3mo util% (m-2,m-1,latest) | Onboard Eng | Billing Tier | Notes

ROWS:
C-2101 | AcmeRetail | us-west1 | A100-80C | 64 | 46080 | 6,000 | 2025-07-01 | 2026-06-30 | 150ms | pool-usw-01 | 74%, 69%, 78% | Sophie Lin | enterprise | Heavy inference daytime spikes; recommend +10% headroom before Black Friday prep. TODO: confirm burst billing cap.
C-2119 | FinSolve | eu-west1,us-east1 | H100 | 32 | 23040 | 2,000 | 2025-09-15 | 2026-09-14 | 120ms | pool-eu-02 | 45%, 53%, 49% | Ravi Kapoor | enterprise+ | Cross-region failover enabled; set routing policy to prefer eu then us-east. Action: run failover drill test (JIRA INF-2389).
C-2167 | HealthGrid | prod-eu | A100-80C (quantized) | 16 | 11520 | 500 | 2025-10-01 | 2026-03-31 | 200ms | pool-eu-01 | 88%, 91%, 93% | Ethan Brooks | regulated | Sustained high utilization — possible QoS risk. Recommend talk with customer about scheduled cache warming and prefetch windows.
C-2190 | DeepEd | ap-southeast1 | T4 | 24 | 17280 | 3,600 | 2025-08-01 | 2026-07-31 | 300ms | pool-aps-01 | 22%, 18%, 25% | Sophie Lin | starter | Low util; consider autoscale min reduction to free 4 GPUs to pool-usw-02.
C-2205 | MediaStream | us-east1 | H100 | 48 | 34560 | 8,000 | 2025-11-01 | 2026-10-31 | 110ms | pool-use-03 | 60%, 66%, 72% | Mariana Alvarez | enterprise | Video transcoding+inference; expect seasonal spike in Q4. Work with infra to reserve burst in use-east region.
C-2234 | GovInsight | us-central1 (private) | A100-80C (private) | 8 | 5760 | 0 | 2025-12-01 | 2026-11-30 | 100ms | pool-private-gov | 95%, 97%, 96% | Ravi Kapoor | enterprise | Air-gapped nodes; no burst allowed. Monitor KV cache eviction daily.

SUMMARY METRICS (current snapshot):
Total reserved GPUs (all contracts): 192
Total effective monthly GPU-hrs reserved: 134,640 hrs
Reserved headroom used (average of latest util): 68%
Recommend short-term rebalancing: reclaim 6 GPUs from low-util pools (DeepEd and pool-eu-02 idle windows) to cover predicted Black Friday delta (~+10% to AcmeRetail).

BILLING NOTES:
- Billing tier mapping included to support finance chargeback. Confirm whether burst consumption is invoiced at on-demand or discounted reserved rate for each contract (open item).
- For customers with private pools (GovInsight), usage tracking must be replicated to central billing collector via secure export (see confluence page).

OPERATIONAL ACTIONS / OPEN ITEMS:
- [ ] Confirm burst billing cap for AcmeRetail with Sales (owner: Mariana) — due 2026-02-22
- [ ] Schedule failover drill for FinSolve (owner: Ravi) — due 2026-03-01 
- [ ] HealthGrid QoS mitigation plan: propose cache-warming schedule (owner: Ethan) — due 2026-02-28
- [ ] Propose reduction of min replicas for DeepEd to free 4 GPUs (owner: Sophie) — due 2026-02-20

NOTES TO SELF / WORKING THOUGHTS:
- pool naming should include region + isolation-level to make quick SRE routing easier (ex: pool-usw-01, pool-usw-01-iso).
- Consider introducing "soft reserve" concept: cheaper preemptible reservation for non-critical burstable workloads (requires contracts/legal).
- Add a column for "quantization profile" (none/8-bit/4-bit) next pass — influences GPU selection and headroom forecasting.

HISTORY:
- 2025-11-04: initial Q3 logbook created during capacity planning sync (Mariana).
- 2025-12-10: added GovInsight private pool details after SOC2 intake (Ravi).
- 2026-01-18: updated utilization with December and January numbers (Sophie).
- 2026-02-15: draft rebalancing recommendations added (Mariana).

REFERENCES / LINKS:
- SLA and reserved rates: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/DED/Reserved+Capacity+SLA
- Current pool inventory dashboard: https://internal.redwood.ai/dash/pools
- Related JIRA: INF-2389 (FinSolve failover), INF-2456 (Black Friday capacity runbook)

END SHEET — working doc: comments welcome in Slack #dedicated-capacity or add edits inline.
